outcome: fetal complication of Low Birth Weight (LBW)
cohort: The study included all patients with Preterm Premature Rupture of membranes who were less than 37 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study concluded an overall increased chance of neonatal morbidity in PPROM, with the majority of patients experiencing fetal complications like LBW (58.33%) and preterm birth (18.51%).
mod_finding: The majority of patients in the study were delivered by LSCS (54.63%).
